method: Independently rendered radius-55 sphere; analytical x/y axis-angle increments, noncommuting pose composition and six known front-facing body landmarks. Stationary controls use 120 frames with independent pixel noise. Actual matcher, shape fit and map selector executed; no neural inference or defect masks.
limitations: Synthetic development controls with perfect silhouettes, fixed camera and two textures. No field or grade accuracy, glare/occlusion evaluation or verified full turn. 3D pose error and landmark errors score the full measured chain; failed chains are unavailable. Partial maps and absence of a grade cannot establish accurate motion.
